title: Dividend Payout Concentration by Ticker
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plaid:investment transaction_type=dividend
| bin _time span=12mon
| stats sum(amount_usd) as annual_dividends_usd by ticker _time
| eventstats sum(annual_dividends_usd) as total_dividends_usd by _time
| eval share_pct=round(100*annual_dividends_usd/total_dividends_usd,1)
| where share_pct>20
| sort - share_pct
description: Uses Plaid dividend records telemetry to monitor how concentrated dividend income is by ticker in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for income streams that depend too heavily on one holding, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Plaid dividend records data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how concentrated dividend income is by ticker so you can spot income streams that depend too heavily on one holding before it becomes annoying.
